name: io.github.motionvideohq/motionvideo
title: MotionVideo
description: Search AI-made motion videos, pull the prompts behind them, and browse motion tools and studios.

tools.name: list-bookmarks
tools.description: List the signed-in user's motionvideo.xyz bookmarks: saved motion videos, tools, studios, skills, and resources, newest first. Signs in with the user's MotionVideo account; the client offers that on first use.

kind.description: Return only bookmarks of one kind

tools.name: my-featured
tools.description: List the signed-in user's motionvideo.xyz community submissions that were featured in the catalog, newest first, with links to the featured entries. Signs in with the user's MotionVideo account; the client offers that on first use.

tools.name: search-videos
tools.description: Search the motionvideo.xyz catalog of AI-made motion videos by keywords, content categories, models, named colours, creators and type, sorted newest or oldest, a page at a time. Several values in one filter are alternatives (colors ["red","orange"] = red or orange); different filters all apply ("Opus 5.5 videos in product UI" = models ["Opus 5.5"] + categories ["product-ui"]). The answer states which filters were applied, what each resolved to, and, when nothing matches, how many videos each filter matches alone. Results include preview and full MP4 links plus the page URL.

categories.description: Content categories, any of them (see list-filters), e.g. ["product-ui"] for "product UI"

colorMatch.description: With several colors: "any" (default) for red OR orange, "all" for videos that contain every one

colors.description: Named colours the video contains, matched like the site's colour pages

creators.description: Creators, any of them: X handles (with or without @) or display names, ignoring case

models.description: Models the video was made with, any of them: a name ("Opus 5.5", "GPT-6 Astra"), a full name ("Claude Opus 5.5"), a family ("Gemini") or a bare version ("5.5" covers Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.5). list-filters lists them

offset.description: Results to skip, for the next page. Defaults to 0

query.description: Keywords; every word must appear in the title, prompt, creator handle, or categories. Use the other filters for models, colours, categories and creators rather than keywords

sort.description: By post date. Defaults to newest

type.description: Only entries that shared a prompt, or that shipped a skill

tools.name: get-video
tools.description: Fetch one motionvideo.xyz catalog entry: the original prompt behind the video, how it was made (model, effort, iterations, stack), live media links, its neighbours and the five most similar videos to keep exploring.

slug.description: Catalog slug from search-videos, e.g. twoclipping-5cba86

tools.name: search-directory
tools.description: Search a motionvideo.xyz directory section: "tools" (editors, AI generators, mockups; filter by pricing: free, freemium, open-source, paid), "skills" (agent skills that make videos; filter by renderer: remotion, hyperframes, html, manim, adobe, blender, video-models, ffmpeg; sort by stars or updated), "creatives" (studios and designers for hire; filter by specialty: product-films, explainers, 3d, brand, ui-motion) or "extras" (articles and resources; filter by resource type). Several filters or categories are alternatives. list-filters shows each section's categories, filters and sorts with counts.

categories.description: The section's categories, any of them, e.g. ["Editor"] for tools or ["Product films"] for skills

filters.description: The section's facet values, any of them (see description)

offset.description: Entries to skip, for the next page. Defaults to 0

query.description: Keywords matched against name, description, category, renderers and specialties

sort.description: added (tools, creatives, skills, extras), stars or updated (skills), newest or oldest (extras); without one, the site's curated order

tools.name: list-filters
tools.description: List every filter value on motionvideo.xyz with how many items carry it: video categories (with descriptions), models, named colours and types for search-videos; each directory section's filters, categories and sorts for search-directory; and the move families for search-moves. Call it when unsure which values exist.

scope.description: Only one group of filters. Defaults to all

tools.name: search-moves
tools.description: MotionVideo Pro: search the motionvideo.xyz Moves library of named motion techniques (easing, kinetic type, transitions, UI motion, camera moves, and more) by keyword and/or family. Returns names, families, summaries, and slugs for get-move-prompt. Signs in with the user's motionvideo.xyz account (the client offers that on first use) and needs a MotionVideo Pro or Business plan on it.

limit.description: Max moves to return (1-30). Defaults to 12

query.description: Text matched case-insensitively against the move's name, other names, summary, and good-for tags

tools.name: get-move-prompt
tools.description: MotionVideo Pro: fetch the copy-ready prompt for one move from the motionvideo.xyz Moves library, with its tunable parameters and page URL. Signs in with the user's motionvideo.xyz account (the client offers that on first use) and needs a MotionVideo Pro or Business plan on it.

slug.description: Move slug from search-moves, e.g. squash-and-stretch
